change: The Next.js App Router application now exists at src/app/ (layout.tsx, page.tsx, site-metadata.ts) with src/lib/ reserved for shared modules. Root config is tsconfig.json and next.config.ts. Worth stating that application code lives under src/, not at the repository root.

Record the TypeScript 7 constraint: the project uses typescript@7 (the native compiler), where baseUrl has been REMOVED and is a hard error (TS5102). The @/* path alias is configured with paths alone, resolving relative to tsconfig.json. Any tooling guide telling a later Epic to add baseUrl predates TS 7 and must not be followed.

Record that tsconfig.json enforces strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitOverride, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames and isolatedModules, and that exactOptionalPropertyTypes is deliberately off. noUncheckedIndexedAccess in particular shapes how later Epics must parse external API payloads: indexed access yields T | undefined and presence may not be assumed.

Open decision needing an owner: next dev (Next 16) generates untracked AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md at the repository root on every start. next build does not. They are currently neither committed nor ignored. Options are to commit them, ignore them, or set agentRules: false in next.config.ts.

Story E00_S01 is complete and verified. All five tasks Passed. The repository builds from a clean clone with npm ci && npm run build on Node 24.18.0, and a type error fails both npm run typecheck and npm run build (demonstrated, exit 1 each). Evidence in project/documentation/summaries/E00_S01_T05-summary.md.

Record that tsconfig.json has NO baseUrl: TypeScript 7 removed the option (hard error TS5102). The @/* -> ./src/* alias is anchored by paths alone, relative to the tsconfig directory, and is verified to resolve under both tsc 7 and Turbopack from a clean clone. E00_S02 must not add baseUrl when configuring Vitest. This deviation should also be appended as a dated entry to docs/decisions.md.

npm audit reports 6 vulnerabilities (5 high, 1 critical), all reachable only via @jenga-ai/agent (protobufjs, sharp, onnx-proto, onnxruntime-web, @xenova/transformers) and all marked 'No fix available'. E00_S04 must decide whether audit becomes a CI gate before wiring it in, otherwise CI is red from its first run. Separately, npm run dev (not build) generates untracked AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md at the repo root and flips next-env.d.ts to the .next/dev/types variant; a subsequent npm run build restores next-env.d.ts, but the two Markdown files need an owner - commit them or set agentRules: false.
